# Moonphase Hair

Moonphase Hair is a free web app for cutting hair according to the lunar cycle.

Docs: /developers
REST API: /api/v1
OpenAPI: /api/v1/openapi
MCP: /api/mcp

## Access

The public API and MCP server are free. No API key or OAuth is required.
CORS is enabled for browser clients.

## REST

- GET /api/v1 — discovery catalog
- GET /api/v1/moon?date= — current or dated moon phase, illumination, timing, and hair advice
- GET /api/v1/phases — all eight phases with hair-cutting guidance
- GET /api/v1/next?phase=Full%20Moon — next occurrence of a named phase
- GET /api/v1/fasting — full-moon fasting window
- GET /api/v1/openapi — OpenAPI 3.1 document

Dates accept ISO-8601, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC midnight), or Unix timestamps.

## MCP tools

- get_current_moon_phase
- get_moon_phase
- list_hair_guides
- get_next_moon_phase
- get_full_moon_fasting

Cursor example:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "moonphase-hair": {
      "url": "https://<your-domain>/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
